poster_caption:
Are you suffering from unexplained brain fog, persistent fatigue, or tingling sensations in your hands and feet? You might be low in Vitamin B12.

Vitamin B12 is crucial for nervous system repair, DNA synthesis, and cellular energy production. Here is what happens when your levels drop:

🩸 01. Chronic Fatigue: Impaired red blood cell formation starves tissues of vital oxygen.
🧠 02. Brain Fog: Nerve insulation degrades, slowing down brain processing speed.
⚡ 03. Pins & Needles: Lack of B12 damages peripheral nerves, causing numbness.

📌 Save this guide for your daily health routine!
